contexts.text: They were taken to the abodes of the scribes (there), who wrote copies of the writings of the wise of the city; and they inspected the writings...
The sceptre of the scribe () = intelligence.
Where is the scribe? () = when there is no intelligence.
I send unto you... scribes () = ... the Word from which is doctrine.
The chief priests and scribes () = adulterations of good and falsifications of truth, both from infernal love.

To abound over (the righteousness) of the scribes and Pharisees () = that there must be internal life, and not external without internal. The scribes and Pharisees were solely in external representatives...
